claim: seed-pool average watch seconds gates expansion
why: 11-28 step-back: early avg watch AUC 0.90 since 11-05, but the blind challenger showed it is near-circular (every hit's early snap was already after expansion; expanded audiences watch ~1.6 s longer; pre-expansion watch AUC only 0.64). A snapshot at ~1h after each post, before expansion, settles it.
rule: films longer than 30 s, not yet expanded at the 1h snap (plays < 260): predict HIT (plays >= 400 at first snap >= 12h) iff avg watch at 1h >= 7.3 s (threshold fitted on pre-11-13 films, fixed now)
pass: AUC of 1h avg watch >= 0.75 AND the 7.3 s rule beats always-floor accuracy
fail: AUC < 0.65 -> watch is a consequence of expansion, not its gate; stop reading arms on watch
meanwhile: arms are read on HIT RATE (plays >= 400 at 12h), paired within day; medians are floor-bound
